{{Quote|I've never seen those moves from a CorSec before. No matter, prepare to die!|Quixio the Rotten|<ref name="SWG:SabttHDL" />}}
'''Quixio the Rotten''' was a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Hidden Daggers]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Rhea]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]] tasked a pilot with [[Death/Legends|killing]] Quixio and four other Hidden Dagger pilots.<ref name="SWG:SabttHDL" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateHiddendaggerPilots.jpg|thumb|right|250px|All possible depictions of Quixio the Rotten]]
Quixio the Rotten appeared aboard a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']], the [[2004]] expansion pack for the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SabttHDL" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
